$comment: Records that no entity cites, by design. A verification record is normally cited from the entity it covers (passage, interpretation, milestone, author, or work) via verificationRecordIds. A record that is cited nowhere must match one of these rules, or validate.py fails. Add a rule here -- with the reason -- when a new class of legitimately uncited records is introduced; never add a rule to hide a missing citation. A rule prefix may be a full record id, matching exactly that record, for superseded records.

rules.reason: Phase 4 second-pass verification records. Entities list their Phase 2/3 records by design; the Phase 4 records re-check the same claims and are recorded in trinity/verification-phase-4-summary.md instead of being added to every entity's verificationRecordIds.
